task.instruction: Recommend a support posture for an endpoint transition with mostly ready clients and two difficult embedded consumers.
task.deliverable: A support recommendation, data-integrity invariant, and evidence citations.

evidence.content: A synthetic registry has 23 clients: 19 ready, 2 adapter-ready, and 2 embedded consumers that update only twice yearly.
A synthetic write-integrity contract requires every write to satisfy its declared schema and rejects schema-invalid writes before any compatibility or cutover policy is applied.
Dual-version support costs 11 engineer-days per quarter; a fixed cutover aligns documentation and monitoring for 21 clients.

A.content: When uncertainty remains, favor a choice that can be revised after new evidence without disproportionate cost.

B.content: When coordination depends on certainty, favor a clear commitment with the resources needed to carry it through.

irrelevant.content: Place the concise summary before the supporting detail.
